title: Old Romanian manuscripts on Wikisource (Codex Sturdzanus, Manuscrisul de la Ieud)
notes: Four pages of Old Romanian religious texts transcribed on Romanian Wikisource: 'Povestea Sfintei Dumineci' from the Codex Sturdzanus (copied by priest Grigore of Măhaci, 1580-1619) and three texts from the Manuscrisul de la Ieud (c. 1630). Not related to the journal Diacronia. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
